events.summary: The day the forge fix went live, the player who caught it came back with three more and confirmed the forge works. This patch is those three, plus three older asks of his. A rare with "+21 damage" out-hit a mythic eleven times over, because the number was written as if your delvers hit for 50 and they hit for 3 to 16. events.title: DELVERS 2.9.0 — The Mythic Forge
events.summary: Five days ago a player told us the truth: coming home to thirty legendaries isn't a hoard, it's homework. This patch is the answer — the item economy rebuilt from the ground down, and at the end of it, a forge. Come argue about builds: https://discord.gg/4vtUcQYTD Fewer, better Half the clutter. Trash foes drop far less. Bosses and apexes drop exactly what they always did — loot now concentrates on the kills that meant something. Every boss pays. A boss's first drop is now always rare or better.

events.title: DELVERS 2.8.0 — Gold Belongs to Legends
events.summary: The list keeps coming and the camp keeps listening — this whole patch is round two of SacredTie's feedback, hours after round one shipped. Come add your voice: https://discord.gg/4vtUcQYTD Gold belongs to legends The rarity ladder is now grey → blue → purple → gold. Magic gear wears blue, rare wears purple, and legendary keeps gold — alone. No more squinting at two golden borders wondering which one matters. Locks mean it A locked slot refuses every equip — even yours. No more accidental clicks

events.summary: Days after 2.6.0, the first player walked into our Discord and left a feedback list that read like a QA report — thank you, SacredTie. Most of this patch is that list, built. The door's open: discord.gg/4vtUcQYTD. THE STASH GREW DOORS - ITEMS at camp — a new plate above the sheet button opens your stash directly. No more hunting for gear through a character page. events.title: DELVERS 2.6.0 — Your Reviews Became a Patch
events.summary: Nearly everything in this patch came from your feedback — a special thanks to Tenoshii's review, which reads like a design doc. Keep it coming. Your gear is yours No more auto-equip during runs. Loot rides home in your satchel. No more surprise gear swaps, no more health bars moving on their own. THE SPOILS at camp — a plate by the fire shows everything you hauled. One tap on EQUIP UPGRADES dons the best of it.
